summary: Fix tune.py: pin Nystroem degree=2/coef0=1 in nested shortlist, extend gamma past 0.5, rerun pilot-only
reasoning: Observation step-11 contradicted plan step-9 only in form (exit 1 from a diagnostic print; sklearn returns scalars in best_params_) and in one real defect: the nested-CV shortlist omitted Nystroem degree=2/coef0=1, so the nested estimate 0.8252 measured a degree-3 kernel, not the degree-2 kernel that scored 0.8846 in the plain grid. The useful pilot-only facts stand: raw logistic 0.6313 (baseline reproduced), RBF tops at 0.8373, poly-2 tops at 0.8846 with the best region gamma 0.25-0.5, C 1-3, comps 100. I fix the shortlist to pin degree=2 and coef0=1.0, extend gamma past the 0.5 edge (0.75, 1.0) so nothing is chosen at a boundary, keep comps 100 vs 300 and C in {0.3, 1, 3}, and recompute the honest 5x3 nested estimate over the top-6 shortlist. Still pilot-only, prints only, single-threaded.
